stem.text: A particle having mass $m$ and charge $+q$ enters a uniform electric field with speed $v$.
Initially, the particle is travelling at right-angles to the electric field.
During its movement through the field, the particle is deflected through distance $d$, as shown.

stem.alt: Particle path entering from the left, passing through a shaded rectangle labelled region of uniform electric field, and leaving the rectangle deflected downwards. The vertical deflection is labelled d.

stem.text: A second particle of mass $2m$, charge $+q$ and speed $v$ enters the electric field along the same path.
What is the distance through which this particle is deflected in the electric field?
